title: Corn, twenty-five
logline: September 12. A tray of corn on the long table and nothing else on the page. Twenty-five years. No caption. The tray knows.

panels.composition: The whole page: a paper tray of corn on the bare wood of the long table, from directly above, the butter running, the salt. Nothing else. No hand, no dog, no wall. The corn is drawn with the care the Sundays gave the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a paper tray of buttered corn on a bare wooden drafting table seen from directly above, drawn with great care, nothing else on the page, no words
image.notes: No caption. The anniversary, silent, twenty-five.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
